schema.description:
An opening is a one-off range of available time for a provider, sitting
alongside their recurring schedules.

end_time.description: The end time of the opening (24-hour clock, e.g. `17:00`).

provider_id.description: The ID of the provider the opening belongs to.

start_time.description: The start time of the opening (24-hour clock, e.g. `09:00`).

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone the opening's times are authored in.

title.description: An optional display title for the opening.

updated_at.description: When the opening was last updated.

schema.title: Opening
